title: Meta introduces Meta Ads AI connectors in open beta, letting advertisers use their preferred third-party AI tools to create, manage, and analyze campaigns (Krystal Scanlon/Digiday)
summary: Krystal Scanlon / Digiday: Meta introduces Meta Ads AI connectors in open beta, letting advertisers use their preferred third-party AI tools to create, manage, and analyze campaigns — In a break from its walled garden approach, Meta is opening its ad ecosystem to third-party AI tools.
